perfil.titulo: From systems integration to data engineering
perfil.corpo: Systems Analyst with experience in systems integration, data processing and building solutions for large-scale corporate environments. I translate business rules into technical solutions, build integrations, analyze data and optimize SQL queries, contributing to the reliability and availability of information. My experience includes SQL, Oracle, REST APIs, Java, Databricks and data integration between systems, as well as data transformation, information quality, requirements analysis and investigating inconsistencies in high-volume environments. I am currently pursuing a graduate program in Data Engineering, deepening my knowledge of Data Engineering, ETL/ELT, Data Pipelines, Data Modeling, Big Data, Apache Spark and Cloud Computing. I also volunteer as a Python instructor, sharing knowledge of logic, programming and data analysis, reinforcing my commitment to continuous learning and to the tech community.
